verdict.rationale: Motion's marketing describes several autonomous background behaviors. It reshuffles the calendar on its own, advances projects when blocking tasks complete, and enforces meeting limits. It also schedules recurring tasks, auto-schedules forwarded emails, and offers an 'AI Workflow Builder' that builds workflows from SOPs. Zapier and a live REST API extend this to custom automations. However, user-configurable automation (custom triggers, conditions and actions) is evidenced only by one-line claims or depends on external tools like Zapier or your own API scripts. Missing for 10: documented native trigger/action automation setup, detail on how the AI Workflow Builder's workflows actually run, and independent or hands-on confirmation that automations run unattended as claimed.
